documents.title: Director charged in invoice scheme
documents.content: Priya Ranganathan, a director of Solace Logistics, was charged with fraud on Tuesday, prosecutors said. The indictment alleges a scheme to inflate customer invoices over four years. Solace Logistics said it is cooperating with investigators.
